'''Karl Koenig''' (GEMP handle '''KrazyKarl''')<ref name="roster">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=81218 SWCCG Teams - Rosters], Joe Olson (21 July 2022; spreadsheet updated 14 September 2025). [[:File:SWCCG Teams Rosters 14 September 2025.txt]]; [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit Google Sheet]; Wayback [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008235350/https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing 8 October 2026]</ref> finished '''#8''' at the [[2025 Las Vegas Grand Prix]].<ref name="pc-2025LasVegasGrandPrix" /> Koenig also finished '''#37''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (Lost Round of 64; Challonge seed 36).<ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref> He helped organize the [[2026 San Diego Super Open]] and secured its event space.<ref name="sdso26">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-san-diego-super-open-wrap-up-joe-olson-conquers/ 2026 San Diego Super Open Wrap-up – Joe Olson Conquers], starwarsccg.org (28 April 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261011191508/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-san-diego-super-open-wrap-up-joe-olson-conquers.html Internet Archive]</ref>
